QuestInfo.name: Sabitrama's Logic
QuestInfo.1: Here's what Sabitrama thinks: If you sit around indoors eating ice cream to beat the heat, you'll only wind up getting fat, which'll make you even hotter. Instead, you should exercise...by eliminating monsters!

0.0: Silly fools. Sitting on their bums eating ice cream to beat the heat... Don't they know they'll all get FAT?! And that'll make the heat feel even worse. NO, what they need to do is exercise. That's the ONLY way to beat the heat.

yes.0: The best exercise is to eliminate monsters. Eliminate  #e#b300 monsters#k#n, and you'll be cool as an iceberg.

no.0: I bet you sit around at home stuffing your face all day long. Hmph.
